title: softlint rules
description: Plain-English rules that softlint enforces on pull requests with Jev. Only write rules a linter can't check.

rule.description: The rule in plain English. Be concrete: say what breaks the rule, e.g. "…retried without an idempotency key".

files.description: Globs of files the rule applies to, e.g. ["src/api/**"]. Omit to apply it to every file.
